title: Umbraco CMS 17.0.0 before 17.7.1 and 18.0.0 before 18.2.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in Management…
description: Umbraco CMS versions 17.0.0 before 17.7.1 and 18.0.0 before 18.2.1 have an authorization bypass vulnerability in the Management API document version endpoints. This flaw allows authenticated back-office users restricted to a start node to access and read document versions outside their permitted tree by GUID. This exposure includes unpublished document values and the ability to alter prevent-cleanup flags.
